name: Avignonesi Poggetto di Sopra Nobile di Montepulciano 2020
varietal: Prugnolo Gentile (Sangiovese) with possible small additions of Merlot and Mammolo
verdictReason: The 2020 vintage of this single-vineyard Nobile di Montepulciano is still young and needs another 2-4 years to fully integrate its tannins and develop secondary complexity.
characteristics: This single-vineyard Nobile from the Poggetto di Sopra plot offers red cherry, plum, dried herbs, tobacco, and earthy notes typical of Prugnolo Gentile. The wine has firm, grippy tannins with good acidity and a savory, mineral-driven finish. Avignonesi is certified biodynamic, lending the wine a precise, terroir-expressive character with excellent aging potential.

name: Gian Luca Colombo Barbera d'Alba Superiore
verdictReason: Barbera d'Alba Superiore is typically approachable young with good fruit expression, and the 2023 vintage is ready to enjoy now while still having a few years of pleasant drinking ahead.
characteristics: This Barbera d'Alba Superiore will likely show vibrant cherry, plum, and blackberry fruit with characteristic high acidity and low tannins typical of the Barbera grape. The Superiore designation indicates some oak aging, lending additional structure, spice, and subtle vanilla notes. Expect a food-friendly, juicy red with a lively finish and excellent balance.

name: I Garagisti di Sorgono Parisi Bovale 2021
verdictReason: This young 2021 Bovale from Sardinia is in its approachable early drinking window, though it can hold for a few more years with some development.
characteristics: Bovale (also known as Muristellu) from Sardinia typically produces medium-to-full bodied reds with dark fruit flavors of blackberry and plum, earthy Mediterranean garrigue notes, and hints of spice. I Garagisti di Sorgono is known for natural, minimal-intervention winemaking with good freshness and authentic terroir expression. Expect firm but approachable tannins, lively acidity, and a savory, rustic character typical of the Sardinian highlands.

name: i vini di Jacopo Friuli Pinot Grigio
producer: i vini di Jacopo (Necotium Srl società agricola)
verdictReason: Friuli Pinot Grigio is made for early drinking and the 2022 vintage is perfectly positioned for immediate enjoyment at its fresh, youthful peak.
characteristics: Expect a crisp, dry white with aromas of green apple, pear, and citrus zest, typical of the Friuli style. The palate is light to medium-bodied with refreshing acidity, mineral undertones, and a clean, dry finish. This is a straightforward, food-friendly wine with more character than basic northern Italian Pinot Grigio due to its Friuli DOC provenance.
